text: Rather than repeating the same task across many workers to reach quality, the architecture verifies quality directly by examining and validating individual worker task performance through reputation verification.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3128900

isBasedOn.name: Decentralized Mechanical Turk Through Verified Reputation

abstract: Instead of repeating work on given tasks to attain high quality work products for micro tasks, Semada uses an architecture of reputation verification that examines micro worker task performance and verifies the validity and quality of the work.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: micro tasks routed through the reputation verification architecture
